reasoning: The payment of USD 13,400 was sent to Victoria Harbour Bank, which rejects trade payments over USD 10,000 without an invoice number. The remittance info only contains "Components Sep" and no invoice reference. Past cases M1, M5 and M8 show the same RR04 code for the same bank caused by missing invoice references.
recommended_action: Ask the client to resend the payment with a proper invoice number (e.g., KCS-xxxx) added to the remittance information and ensure the format meets Victoria Harbour Bank's requirements.
draft_message: Dear Kestrel Components, your USD 13,400 payment to Kowloon Circuit Supplies Ltd was rejected by Victoria Harbour Bank (RR04) because the remittance information did not include an invoice reference. Please resend the payment with the appropriate invoice number (e.g., KCS-xxxx) included. Thank you.
prevention_tip: Always include the invoice number in remittance info for trade payments over USD 10,000 to Victoria Harbour Bank.
